question: Do senior postings list more skills than non-senior postings of the same role family?
data: data_jobs 2023, postings with extracted skills, role families with a Senior variant
h0: Within each role family, the distribution of skill counts is the same for senior and non-senior postings.
test: Mann-Whitney U per role family, Holm correction across the 3 tests
assumptions: Independent observations; ordinal/continuous outcome. Skill counts are skewed (see skewness columns), so a rank test is used instead of a t-test. Mean differences with 95% CI (Welch/normal approximation, valid at these sample sizes) are reported for readability.
effect_size: Cliff's delta (= rank-biserial r): P(senior > non-senior) - P(senior < non-senior); |d| < 0.147 negligible, < 0.33 small, < 0.474 medium, else large
